scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.test:server:docker: docker rm -f mern-admin-web-mongo-test >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && docker run -d --rm --name mern-admin-web-mongo-test -p 27018:27017 mongo:8 >/dev/null && TEST_MONGO_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018/mern-admin-web-test npm run test --workspace server; STATUS=$?; docker rm -f mern-admin-web-mongo-test >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit $STATUS
scripts.verify: npm run test:server && npm run build
scripts.verify:docker: npm run test:server:docker && npm run build
